text:
A court would likely rule that no contract was formed. Costco’s catalog was an invitation to deal, so Rainmaking’s purchase order was the offer, and Costco’s confirmation—expressly conditioning acceptance on a $50-per-thousand loading charge—was a counteroffer under UCC §2-207(1). Without Rainmaking’s assent to that counteroffer, the parties have no contract.

CONFIDENCE: 78
